title: Surface Stokes-Cahn-Hilliard System: Analysis and Structure-Preserving Discretization
summary: We study the surface Stokes-Cahn-Hilliard system governing tangential flow and phase separation in viscous fluid membranes. The equations are posed on a closed, stationary $C^2$ hypersurface $Γ\subset\mathbb{R}^{d+1}$, $d=2,3$. For constant viscosity and mobility and a class of regular double-well potentials, we prove global existence and uniqueness of weak solutions for initial phase fields in $H^1(Γ)$, with the velocity chosen orthogonal to the Killing fields.
